mapper.select: select d.basis basis, d.yield*100 yield, DATE_FORMAT(d.eff_date,'%Y-%m-%d') effDate from FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT a left join FIN_PRODUCT b on a.finprod_id = b.finprod_id inner join (select a.finprod_id, a.finprod_type, a.branch, c.basis, c.yield, c.eff_date from FIN_CASH_INFO a left join FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE c on a.cash_id = c.cash_id where a.cash_type_2='C19' ) d on a.finprod_id = d.finprod_id and a.finprod_type = d.finprod_type and a.branch = d.branch where a.finprod_id=#{finprodId} and a.finprod_type=#{finprodType} and a.branch=#{branchNo}

select DATE_FORMAT(d.vdate,'%Y-%m-%d') vdate1, DATE_FORMAT(d.mdate,'%Y-%m-%d') mdate1 from FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT a left join FIN_PRODUCT b on a.finprod_id = b.finprod_id inner join (select a.finprod_id, a.finprod_type, a.branch, b.vdate, b.mdate from FIN_CASH_INFO a left join FIN_CASH_PLAN b on a.cash_id = b.cash_id where a.cash_type_2='C19' ) d on a.finprod_id = d.finprod_id and a.finprod_type = d.finprod_type and a.branch = d.branch where a.finprod_id=#{finprodId} and a.finprod_type=#{finprodType} and a.branch=#{branchNo}

select a.finprod_id finprodId, b.finprod_name finprodName, a.finprod_type finprodType, a.branch_type branchType, a.branch branchNo, DATE_FORMAT(d.vdate,'%Y-%m-%d') vdate1, DATE_FORMAT(d.mdate,'%Y-%m-%d') mdate1, d.basis basis, d.yield*100 yield, c.is_accr_penalty_int ifPenalty, e.is_rush_back ifRushBack from FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT a left join FIN_PRODUCT b on a.finprod_id = b.finprod_id left join FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT_ADD c on a.finprod_id=c.finprod_id and a.branch=c.branch left join FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT e on a.finprod_id=e.finprod_id and a.branch=e.branch inner join (select a.finprod_id, a.finprod_type, a.branch, a.cash_id, b.vdate, b.mdate, c.basis, c.yield from FIN_CASH_INFO a left join (select a.cash_id,a.mdate,a.vdate from FIN_CASH_PLAN a, (select cash_id,max(mdate) mdate from FIN_CASH_PLAN group by cash_id) b where a.cash_id=b.cash_id and a.mdate=b.mdate) b on a.cash_id = b.cash_id left join (select a.cash_id, b.eff_date, a.basis, a.yield from FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE a, (select cash_id, min(eff_date) eff_date from FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE group by cash_id) b where a.cash_id = b.cash_id and a.eff_date = b.eff_date) c on a.cash_id = c.cash_id where a.cash_type_2='C19' ) d on a.finprod_id = d.finprod_id and a.finprod_type = d.finprod_type and a.branch = d.branch where a.finprod_id=#{finprodId} and a.finprod_type=#{finprodType} and a.branch=#{branchNo}
